text:
triage-bot: Nightly perf alert: small-batch runner p50 up 28% compared to baseline. CI job: nightly-smallbatch-9pm. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/3625554321 :warning:
maya: saw this in the dashboard too. regression appears only for sequences <8 tokens, weirdly.
ashwin: can you paste the sample test id?
maya: sample id s-batch-7seq-030, logs at /artifacts/nightly/3625554321/s-batch-7seq-030.log
lee: quick guess — small-batch path uses the fast-kv-cache but we pushed an allocator tweak yesterday. could be fragmentation.
ashwin: I can repro locally on my dev GPU. Running the bench now with --seq-max=8.
sam: FYI I rolled back the allocator flags on one dev pool at 22:50 to compare, that might help isolate.
maya: thanks. can someone bisect the nightly job commits between 22:00-23:30? I only see one change: runtime/allocator: enable-slab-opts.
lee: assigning to ashwin for initial bisect, sam for comparison VM runs.
ashwin: will run a quick bisect tomorrow morning, but if it's reproing locally I can try a targeted binary build. ETA 30m.
maya: if ashwin is busy I can capture perf counters: nvprof + top-down on the small-batch runner. command: `./bench_smallbatch --id s-batch-7seq-030 --trace nvprof --out /tmp/trace.nvvp`
triage-bot: note: nightly job retained artifacts for 14 days, attach if you capture anything.
sam: I started a hermetic run on vm-dev-14 with old allocator and new allocator, will post timings in 10m.
ashwin: quick note — when I reproduce, p50 jumps only when concurrency > 12. single-run latency unchanged. maybe a scheduler/batcher interaction.
maya: good catch. that explains why unit tests didn't catch it. add concurrency to bisect matrix.
lee: I'll look at the batcher codepath around flush threshold. maybe a boundary condition for tiny sequences.
ashwin: attaching a trace snippet to the thread (summarized): extra 1.5ms spin in scheduler when seq len <8 and batch size=1. looks like a wakeup path.
maya: next steps: ashwin to bisect and PR a revert/hotfix if confirmed; lee to scan batcher flush logic; sam to compare VM runs and share perf.csv. I'll create a follow-up issue: INF-4721.
lee: tagging infra oncall @infra-team for possible kernel scheduler params if we need to tune.
ashwin: confirmed cause is allocator slab spin when under contention; adding a micro-retry removed the spin in my local build, p50 back to baseline. will open a PR with perf numbers.
maya: awesome — if PR looks good, let's land a quick revert on nightly and then include a proper fix.
sam: perf.csv from vm-dev-14: new-alloc p50 18.2ms, old-alloc 14.1ms, concurrency 16. posted to artifacts link.
triage-bot: update: nightly job flagged green after rolling back allocator flag in canary pool at 02:15. Closing loop when PR merged. :white_check_mark:
